blocks.text: Many libraries and research databases are online, giving access to scholarly resources. Academic journals publish articles by experts that are usually peer-reviewed, checked by other experts before publication, which makes them trustworthy. Students can reach them through school libraries, university portals or open-access websites; for a project on pollution and local ecosystems, search environmental-science journals. Many universities in Pakistan provide online libraries, and Google Scholar and ResearchGate give free access to some papers.

blocks.prompt: What does 'peer-reviewed' mean (MCQ 5)? What is a key purpose of online libraries (MCQ 6)?
blocks.explanation: (c) reviewed by other experts in the field; (b) offering a variety of academic resources.

items: Online libraries and databases give peer-reviewed journals (Google Scholar, university portals).
